thread:
emi: Quick thread on Keiko (Tokyo)  onboarding hiccup: laptop shipment flagged at customs and her residence card upload to kiosk failed due to non-UTF filename. Start date Thu UTC+9. Need contingency for day-1.

keiko: Hi! I uploaded my zairyu card but got an error 'invalid filename encoding'. I can attach again but worried about laptop. Customs message says clearance delayed 48-72h.

tom: Payroll note  Japan hires need MyNumber for payroll, but it's OK to provisionally onboard without it; payroll will hold until MyNumber is provided. We'll need bank details though.

rina: Security: For remote onboarding we require valid photo ID + selfie. Residence card is acceptable. Portal sometimes chokes on multibyte filenames; ppl-ops can sanitize & upload. For BYOD exceptions we can create scoped VPN denylist and block prod access.

onboard-bot: action: send-keiko-checklist -> "Please resend residence_card.jpg (rename to ascii, e.g., keiko_rc.jpg) and selfie holding card. If laptop delayed, we'll enable BYOD limited access until hardware arrives."

itbot: shipping-note: laptop held by customs (carrier: Yamato) due to missing commercial invoice copy. Candidate used personal billing address; carrier requested additional docs. Clearance ETA 48-72h.

emi: I'll contact carrier and request invoice for release; also offering Keiko BYOD temporary access so she can join Mon.

keiko: I can share invoice from seller and resend sanitized filename now. Also I have a personal laptop I can use for day-1 if BYOD policy ok.

emi: Please email docs to onboarding@redwood.example with subject "UPLOAD: KEIKO" and rename files ascii. We'll ingest.

itbot: file-received: onboarding@ -> keiko_rc.jpg (2.8MB). Attempting sanitize... success. Portal accepted id.

bg-bot: Background-check: vendor requests name in romaji and kanji for matching. Keiko please confirm both exactly as on residence card. Also vendor requested selfie-with-card; we have one now. Manual review flagged for name script mismatch; vendor will clear after romaji confirmation.

keiko: Romaji on card: "Keiko Tanaka". Kanji: "田中恵子". Confirming now.

bg-bot: Noted. Vendor cleared after romaji-kanji match. Background-check moved to 'in progress' with no flags.

rina: Security approves BYOD scoped access: create ticket `onboard-byod-2765432100`. Access: internal dev/staging only, MFA enforced, no SSO to prod tools. Auto-revoke in 10 days or on laptop arrival.

emi: Ticket created: infra-requests #9128. Keiko will get a temporary profile with staging-only roles.

itbot: Carrier update: Yamato requested commercial invoice by EOD JST; emi sent docs. If cleared, delivery possible tomorrow morning JST.

keiko: Thank you! Also quick Q: am I eligible to enroll in benefits right away or after MyNumber is provided?

tom: Benefits: enrollment invite will be sent and you can complete elections week 1; final payroll eligibility awaits MyNumber but no need to wait to review plans. We'll send benefits portal link and deadline.

onboard-bot: calendar: Day-1 orientation invite sent for Thu 10:00 JST; buddy assigned: rina.

emi: Summary: residence card sanitized & accepted, BG vendor cleared pending romaji match (now ok), customs delay being handled (carrier docs sent), provisional BYOD access approved and ticketed, payroll will provisionally onboard without MyNumber, benefits orientation scheduled. We'll flip to full laptop access once hardware clears.

keiko: Great, thanks everyone! Appreciate the BYOD option 44b I'll be online for the 10:00 JST call.

emi: Closing thread for now; will post update if customs clears early or if carrier asks for more docs.
